Tonight, every dream you have will appear on every screen in the world.
Your boss sees you flying. Your crush sees... everything.
By morning, billions of dreams are streaming live.
Then one stranger's dream goes viral.
A bridge collapses, and a clock reads 3:07 PM. Tomorrow.
Nobody believes it. Until 3:07... when it happens. Exactly like the dream.
The world stops asking what dreams mean.
And starts asking: whose dream is next?
